author: WP09
summary: Older SDL_GPU campaign narrative: dependency argument, SDL_gpu shader convention and Y-flip, skinned palette, runtime GLSL ShaderEffect and the .cnj boundary, pipeline snapshots and hashing, draw order, present timing, validation findings, render-target lifetime, MRT, usage, Texture3D cycling, swapchain recovery and open items. Partly stale at 009d40f5: the palette is now a texture, back-buffer depth follows DepthFormat, instancing exists, cube MSAA uses per-face textures and occlusion creation throws. The Development internals page already held much of the mechanism; the rationale, tests and corrections went into two SDL_GPU deep dives.

concepts.section: Legacy SDL GPU Chapter Material
concepts.text: SDL_GPU implements CNA's renderer contract on SDL3's SDL_gpu API: it owns an SDL_GPUDevice, records draws in CPU-side queues and acquires a command buffer and swapchain texture only at flush.

concepts.section: Legacy SDL GPU Chapter Material
concepts.text: The renderer was covered late in the source material, a gap in the documentation rather than in CNA's code.
concepts.note: Narrative about the documentation's own coverage history; no technical claim.

concepts.section: Why this renderer costs nothing new
concepts.text: SDL_gpu dispatches internally to Vulkan, Direct3D 12 or Metal depending on platform and driver availability.

concepts.section: Why this renderer costs nothing new
concepts.text: The SDL_gpu implementation is part of the vendored SDL3, so on Linux the renderer adds no third-party dependency; at the snapshot Windows and Apple builds default CNA_SDL_GPU_SHADERCROSS on (pinned SDL_shadercross and SPIRV-Cross) and GLSL ShaderEffect needs a target-native libshaderc.
tokens: There is no separate SDL_gpu library
concepts.note: The source unit said zero new dependency; true only for the Linux/Vulkan route.

concepts.section: Why this renderer costs nothing new
concepts.text: Main class CNA::Internal::Renderers::SdlGpu::SdlGpuRenderer, sources under modules/renderers/sdl-gpu/src, target cna_renderer_sdl_gpu, selected with -DCNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERER=SDL_GPU.

concepts.section: Why this renderer costs nothing new
concepts.text: The SdlGpuRenderer name is deliberately distinct from SdlRenderer (the 2D SDL_RENDERER identity on SDL's unrelated SDL_Renderer API) so the similar SDL names do not collide.

concepts.section: Precompiled bytecode only, in a fixed resource-binding order
concepts.text: SDL_CreateGPUShader accepts only format-tagged bytecode (SPIR-V, DXBC/DXIL, MSL or metallib), never GLSL or HLSL source.

concepts.section: Precompiled bytecode only, in a fixed resource-binding order
concepts.text: SDL_gpu fixes resource sets per stage (vertex textures/storage set 0, vertex uniforms set 1, fragment textures/storage set 2, fragment uniforms set 3), a different layout from the Vulkan renderer's shaders.
concepts.note: The source unit described the convention in HLSL register terms (t/s/u/b); CNA's shaders use the SPIR-V set form.

concepts.section: Precompiled bytecode only, in a fixed resource-binding order
concepts.text: Vulkan's compiled SPIR-V is an algorithmic reference but not reusable output for SDL_GPU; every stock shader was re-authored for SDL_gpu's sets; Vulkan-layout packages are accepted at run time only through the SPIR-V remapper.
concepts.note: The runtime remapper is new relative to the source unit.

concepts.section: Precompiled bytecode only, in a fixed resource-binding order
concepts.text: SDL_GPU's stock shaders are 23 GLSL sources under src/shaders compiled offline by compile_shaders.py into the checked-in spirv_shaders.hpp; the shadow-sampling include is shared with the Vulkan renderer through CNA_SHADOW_* defines.
concepts.note: The source unit's list of pairs predates removal of instanced3d.vert.glsl.

concepts.section: The screenshot that exposed a Y-flip
concepts.text: SDL_gpu's Vulkan driver flips clip-space Y internally; the first sprite shader drew every sprite upside down without error; sprite2d.vert.glsl negates ndc.y; only a captured screenshot revealed it.

concepts.section: The screenshot that exposed a Y-flip
concepts.text: The isolating diagnostic sdlgpu_diag_single_sprite.cpp (one plain full-texture sprite with native back-buffer presentation) was kept in the tree as a manual tool, not a CTest.

concepts.section: The screenshot that exposed a Y-flip
concepts.text: A 'did it throw' test cannot catch a wrong-but-plausible image; a pixel or screenshot check is needed.

concepts.section: SkinnedEffect's storage-buffer workaround and push-uniform limit
concepts.text: SDL_gpu's pushed-uniform blocks are limited to about 4,096 bytes on CNA's Vulkan driver (an empirical binary-search measurement, undocumented in SDL_gpu.h), smaller than SkinnedEffect's 72 x 64 = 4,608-byte palette; other stock effects keep uniform pushes.

concepts.section: SkinnedEffect's storage-buffer workaround and push-uniform limit
concepts.text: The source unit said SkinnedEffect's bone matrices use a vertex storage buffer; at the snapshot the palette is a 288x1 RGBA32F sampler texture at vertex set 0 binding 0, because the storage-buffer route made Direct3D 12 reject the pipeline; the row is 256-byte aligned for Direct3D 12 uploads.

concepts.section: Custom ShaderEffect runtime compilation without a development package
concepts.text: SDL_GPU compiles GLSL ShaderEffect source to SPIR-V at run time with a linked target-native libshaderc (CNA_SDL_GPU_SHADER_EFFECTS); SPIR-V payloads use a compiler-free intake available in every build.

concepts.section: Custom ShaderEffect runtime compilation without a development package
concepts.text: Because no libshaderc development package was available, SdlGpuRenderer.cpp hand-declares the extern "C" shaderc entry points it calls (shaderc_compiler_initialize, shaderc_compile_into_spv, shaderc_result_get_bytes and helpers) with enum values as named constants; compilation still uses the real shared library.

concepts.section: Custom ShaderEffect runtime compilation without a development package
concepts.text: The Vulkan renderer's ShaderEffect does not compile GLSL at all: it takes SPIR-V words and refuses GLSL text, despite ShaderEffect's source-oriented contract.
tokens: takes SPIR-V words, not GLSL text

concepts.section: Custom ShaderEffect runtime compilation without a development package
concepts.text: CustomEffects means a renderer accepts an effect, not that it executes the source; ExecutesShaderEffectSourceEXT and the declared dialect answer that; SDL_GPU declares SPIR-V and does not claim GLSL even where the GLSL route exists.

concepts.section: The .cnj fixture exposes the remaining shader-compatibility boundary
concepts.text: CnjEffectTest.LoadsRealCnjFixture's GLSL ES 3.00 pair (loose uniforms, unqualified stage I/O) is not accepted by SDL_GPU's Vulkan-rule GLSL route, so that .cnj effect is invalid on this renderer.

concepts.section: The .cnj fixture exposes the remaining shader-compatibility boundary
concepts.text: SdlGpu_ShaderEffect proves the supported dialect: #version 450, explicit locations, fragment sampler at set 2 binding 0, uniform blocks at set 1 (vertex) and set 3 (fragment), with a tint readback and a white control draw.

concepts.section: The .cnj fixture exposes the remaining shader-compatibility boundary
concepts.text: SDL_GPU's GLSL route creates the vertex shader with one uniform buffer and the fragment shader with one sampler and one uniform buffer, so a custom GLSL effect must fit that shape.
tokens: one sampler and one uniform buffer

concepts.section: The .cnj fixture exposes the remaining shader-compatibility boundary
concepts.text: Closing the .cnj gap needs a designed decision: migrate the shared .cnj source convention to the portable dialect (changing content expectations everywhere) or add a real loose-GLSL translation layer to SDL_GPU.

concepts.section: Pipeline state is snapshotted at draw time, except where it is deliberately not
concepts.text: Each queued SDL_GPU sprite or 3D command carries a RenderStateSnapshot taken when issued (blend, write masks, cull, fill, depth bias, stencil, depth fields).

concepts.section: Pipeline state is snapshotted at draw time, except where it is deliberately not
concepts.text: SDL_GPU folds topology, depth fields, per-slot colour formats, sample count, depth-stencil format and the snapshot into one std::size_t key with a boost-style HashCombine, replacing a hand-packed integer key.

concepts.section: Pipeline state is snapshotted at draw time, except where it is deliberately not
concepts.text: Conditional hashing: disabled blend, disabled stencil and disabled two-sided stencil do not hash their sub-fields; stencil masks are hashed after Uint8 truncation; slot formats (SDLGPU-72) and depth-format presence (REMED-GFX-097) are required dimensions.

concepts.section: Pipeline state is snapshotted at draw time, except where it is deliberately not
concepts.text: The colour format in SDL_GPU's pipeline key comes from the swapchain texture SDL actually returns each frame, not from the public BackBufferFormat; GetAppliedBackBufferFormatEXT reports Color.

concepts.section: Pipeline state is snapshotted at draw time, except where it is deliberately not
concepts.text: The source unit said SDL_GPU always allocates a D24S8 or D32S8 back-buffer depth attachment and that DepthFormat::None does not suppress it.
concepts.note: At 009d40f5 the back-buffer depth attachment follows the public DepthFormat: None means none; Depth16/Depth24 fall back to D32_FLOAT.

concepts.section: Pipeline state is snapshotted at draw time, except where it is deliberately not
concepts.text: SDL_GPU sends the stencil reference per draw through SDL_SetGPUStencilReference; a left-half stencil write followed by an Equal-reference draw proves it (SdlGpu_RenderState).

concepts.section: Pipeline state is snapshotted at draw time, except where it is deliberately not
concepts.text: SDL_GPU viewport, scissor and blend constants are snapshotted per queued draw and applied with SDL_SetGPUViewport, SDL_SetGPUScissor and SDL_SetGPUBlendConstants immediately before it; enabled scissors clamp, disabled or degenerate ones expand to the full target.

concepts.section: Pipeline state is snapshotted at draw time, except where it is deliberately not
concepts.text: SDL_GPU depth bias is pipeline-static: NormalizeDepthBias scales DepthBias per depth format (2^23-1, 2^24-1, 2^16-1) like FNA3D's SDL_gpu driver, disables bias for lines and points, canonicalises signed zero and hashes the result; enable_depth_clip is set on every pipeline (REMED-GFX-051).

concepts.section: Pipeline state is snapshotted at draw time, except where it is deliberately not
concepts.text: SDL_GPU sampler key and descriptor carry every TextureFilter value mapped per component, U/V/W addressing, MaxAnisotropy clamped 1..16 and applied only for Anisotropic, MaxMipLevel as min_lod and MipMapLevelOfDetailBias (REMED-GFX-170).

concepts.section: Deferred rendering still preserves the game's draw order
concepts.text: SDL_GPU once replayed every 3D family first and every sprite last regardless of the game's call order.
concepts.note: Fixed: PushDrawOrder appends a reference per queued draw and RenderQueuedDraws replays chronologically.

concepts.section: Deferred rendering still preserves the game's draw order
concepts.text: Every Queue*Draw and QueueSprite appends a kind/index reference through PushDrawOrder; RenderQueuedDraws makes one chronological pass per target without sorting, and pipeline-rebind avoidance works across all kinds.

concepts.section: Deferred rendering still preserves the game's draw order
concepts.text: SdlGpu_DrawOrder is discriminating: an opaque red full-target sprite and an opaque green full-target 3D quad in both orders with depth off must read green then red; the old order read red twice.

concepts.section: Present timing belongs to the device manager, not a test-only renderer poke
concepts.text: GraphicsDeviceManager defaults SynchronizeWithVerticalRetrace to true; CNA's virtual test display has no useful retrace, so SDL_GPU examples set the property false through the public API before Game::DoInitialize (36 of the 50 example sources).
concepts.note: The source unit counted 22 examples; recounted at TARGET.

concepts.section: Present timing belongs to the device manager, not a test-only renderer poke
concepts.text: GraphicsDevice::Reset once did not forward the presentation interval to IGraphicsRenderer::SetSwapInterval; after the repair it overwrote early private SetSwapInterval(0) pokes, exposing test timeouts instead of preserving an ordering dependency.

concepts.section: Present timing belongs to the device manager, not a test-only renderer poke
concepts.text: SDL_GPU interval 0 requests IMMEDIATE, then MAILBOX (recorded as applied interval 1); any positive interval is VSYNC; SDL_gpu has no half-rate mode so PresentInterval.Two equals One; a refused swapchain-parameter call keeps the previous value.

concepts.section: Two violations exposed by validation mode
concepts.text: SDL_GPU requests SDL_gpu debug_mode (validation) in builds without NDEBUG and not in release builds, mirroring the Direct3D 11 renderer's rule.
tokens: on whenever NDEBUG is not defined

concepts.section: Two violations exposed by validation mode
concepts.text: SDL_gpu forbids multisampled array textures; RenderTargetCube MSAA now uses six single-layer multisampled 2D textures, one per face, resolving into the cube's layers (REMED-GFX-141); the intermediate single shared texture could not preserve content because cycling is illegal with LOADOP_LOAD.
concepts.note: The source unit described the single shared attachment as the final design.

concepts.section: Two violations exposed by validation mode
concepts.text: Automatic mip generation on plain Texture3D/TextureCube needed COLOR_TARGET and made SDL 3.5's Vulkan path build invalid depth-plane views; REMED-GFX-099 made plain Texture3D SAMPLER-only with authored levels, and plain TextureCube is authored too.

concepts.section: Two violations exposed by validation mode
concepts.text: SdlGpu_Texture3D_Validity is construction-only with validation fatal; SdlGpu_Texture3D covers the data contract (planes, partial box, three-level chain, write orders, two resources, NPOT chain, destruction).

concepts.section: Two violations exposed by validation mode
concepts.text: Validation is evidence with scope: it first exposed tolerated violations and then forced the design back to the public resource contract rather than suppressing diagnostics.
tokens: Validation is evidence with a scope

concepts.section: A pre-release render-target use-after-free
concepts.text: A render target destroyed before SDL_GPU's deferred pass executed caused a use-after-free; SdlGpuRenderTarget2DState and SdlGpuRenderTargetCubeState hold native handles kept alive by shared_ptr from commands and segments.

concepts.section: A pre-release render-target use-after-free
concepts.text: The use-after-free was confirmed by a real segmentation fault while the MRT test was first being written, before any release.
concepts.note: Discovery narrative; the header of sdlgpu_mrt_test.cpp at 009d40f5 records it; the current mechanism is a separate PRESERVED concept.

concepts.section: A regression that makes destruction precede submission
concepts.text: SdlGpu_RenderTargetLifetime creates an 8x8 local target, clears it red, samples it into a live 16x16 blue target, destroys it before Present, requires exact red, then repeats for 120 frames.

concepts.section: A regression that makes destruction precede submission
concepts.text: Two lifetime stages: shared_ptr references until the frame has rendered, then the state destructor queues handles into pendingTextureReleases_, released with SDL_ReleaseGPUTexture after a successful submit; a recording never releases a handle an unsubmitted command names.

concepts.section: MRT as a shader capability
concepts.text: SetRenderTargets makes the first target primary and the others extra attachments of one pass; the pipeline key includes the attachment count and formats; all attachments share blend factors while write masks are per slot; the segment's clear colour applies to every colour attachment.

concepts.section: MRT as a shader capability
concepts.text: Stock shaders have one output, so under MRT target 0 receives the draw; SdlGpu_MRT's custom two-output effect reads (51,102,204,255) and (102,204,51,255) from one draw; it also varies count up to four and drives compiled oC0/oC1 output (SDLGPU-75).

concepts.section: MRT as a shader capability
concepts.text: Each PassSegment retains primary and secondary MRT attachments as shared_ptr, so destroying a public secondary target cannot invalidate a recorded bind cycle.

concepts.section: Usage selects per-resource first-use load/store behavior
concepts.text: Each 2D target and cube face has independent first-use colour/depth/stencil flags; the Discard bind clear is recorded into the new segment, Preserve records none, later cycles load unless an explicit clear selects an aspect.

concepts.section: Usage selects per-resource first-use load/store behavior
concepts.text: SDL_GPU cube usage: a single-sample face loads its layer; a multisampled face keeps a persistent per-face attachment and uses RESOLVE_AND_STORE when preserving or when a later segment loads it, plain RESOLVE otherwise; PlatformContents preserves.

concepts.section: Texture3D's cycle=true orphaned-write defect
concepts.text: SDL_UploadToGPUTexture with cycle=true may give the texture fresh backing memory, orphaning earlier partial writes; SDL_GPU's first Texture3D upload path copied cycle=true and lost earlier slices.

concepts.section: Texture3D's cycle=true orphaned-write defect
concepts.text: SDL_GPU upload cycling rule: Texture3D and TextureCube uploads use cycle=false; Texture2D cycles only when it has a single level, because cycling a chain discards the levels not written.
concepts.note: The source unit said Texture2D's cycle=true path is untouched; at TARGET a mipmapped Texture2D does not cycle.

concepts.section: Texture3D's cycle=true orphaned-write defect
concepts.text: A discriminating test for orphaned writes writes different colours to different, off-centre parts of one resource in separate calls and reads each back.

concepts.section: Forced swapchain failure preserves the queued frame
concepts.text: SDL_GPU acquisition: a successful call with a null texture (e.g. minimised window) is a non-error skip that still submits; a false return submits, then throws with SDL_GetError, keeping framePending_ so the queued frame survives.

concepts.section: Forced swapchain failure preserves the queued frame
concepts.text: SdlGpu_SwapchainRecovery forces the hard failure with SDL_ReleaseWindowFromGPUDevice on frame 10, reclaims the window, presents the preserved frame and renders 30 further frames.

concepts.section: What remains open
concepts.text: Occlusion queries are an SDL_gpu API limitation (no query commands in SDL_gpu 3.5.0); at the snapshot CreateOcclusionQuery throws NotSupportedException (the source unit said it returns nullptr) and the capability is false.

concepts.section: What remains open
concepts.text: The source unit said SDL_GPU does not override DrawInstancedPrimitivesEx and overclaims the Instancing capability.
concepts.note: Instancing is implemented (stock families, compiled and custom effects) and the capability is authored true.

concepts.section: What remains open
concepts.text: Closed former SDL_GPU limits: depth and slope bias per pipeline, full sampler key with MaxAnisotropy, MRT secondaries retained by segments, Texture2D native mip count with UpdatePixelsLevel and no automatic downsampling of plain textures.

concepts.section: What remains open
concepts.text: Back-buffer readback lazily enables a self-owned proxy on the first GetBackBufferData, blits it to the swapchain and downloads through a transfer buffer and fence with BGRA-to-RGBA conversion; nothing is paid before the first read.

concepts.section: What remains open
concepts.text: Windows (Direct3D 12) and Apple (Metal) SDL_gpu drivers are code paths rather than validation claims until run on real (or Wine-class) hardware.

concepts.section: Clear state is per segment and issue-ordered
concepts.text: SDL_GPU clears are per segment: consecutive clears before a draw coalesce into the load action per aspect, a clear after a draw opens a new segment over the same destination, MSAA segments use RESOLVE_AND_STORE when a later segment loads.

concepts.section: Clear state is per segment and issue-ordered
concepts.text: The renderer-neutral clear-options, ordered-clear, pass-boundary and back-buffer-order suites prove clear ordering on SDL_GPU without intermediate flushes.

concepts.section: Verification methodology
concepts.text: The source unit counted 83 SdlGpu_* CTest registrations.
concepts.note: Count at an older revision; at 009d40f5 examples/CMakeLists.txt has 135 cna_register_renderer_test calls; per the site's counting rule no per-renderer count is published.

concepts.section: Verification methodology
concepts.text: SDL_GPU tests are registered with cna_register_renderer_test, skip (code 77) through the GPU launcher when no display or adapter is available, and fail on validation output; CNA's records place routine execution on SDL_gpu's Vulkan driver on Linux.

examples.text: GraphicsDeviceManager setup disabling vertical retrace before initialisation

examples.note: Matches the test at 009d40f5; RenderTarget2D constructor and SpriteBatch::Draw overloads checked.

The source listing used a non-existent (level, x, y, z, w, h, d) SetData overload; recreated with XNA's (level, left, top, right, bottom, front, back, data, startIndex, elementCount) signature and labelled illustrative.

issues.text: The shared .cnj GLSL ES 3.00 effect fixture is not accepted by SDL_GPU's Vulkan-rule GLSL route; custom GLSL effects must use #version 450 with explicit locations and SDL_gpu sets.

CnjEffectTest.LoadsRealCnjFixture expects a valid effect on a renderer that reports CustomEffects, executes source and declares a non-HLSL dialect; under SDL_GPU with libshaderc that expectation conflicts with the renderer's rejection of GLSL ES 3.00 (not executed; whether CnaTests is run under SDL_GPU is not established).
SDL_gpu 3.5.0 exposes no occlusion-query commands, so SDL_GPU refuses OcclusionQuery creation.
SDL_GPU's Direct3D 12 and Metal driver routes have no native execution evidence (Direct3D 12 only via Wine/vkd3d-proton; Metal none); no workflow selects SDL_GPU.
SDL_gpu's pushed-uniform limit (about 4,096 bytes measured on the Vulkan driver) forces SkinnedEffect's 4,608-byte palette into a texture.
SDL_GPU drew every sprite upside down because SDL_gpu's Vulkan driver flips clip-space Y.
SDL_GPU replayed every 3D family before every sprite regardless of the game's draw order.
Destroying a render target before SDL_GPU's deferred pass executed caused a use-after-free.
SDL_GPU Texture3D uploads used cycle=true and orphaned earlier sub-volume writes.
SDL_GPU violated SDL_gpu contracts (multisampled cube array; auto-mip without COLOR_TARGET; invalid 3D depth-plane views), hanging the Vulkan driver under validation.
SDL_GPU reported the Instancing capability while DrawInstancedPrimitivesEx fell to the throwing default.
SDL_GPU's CreateOcclusionQuery returned nullptr, which could make Begin/End silent no-ops.
GraphicsDevice::Reset did not forward the presentation interval to IGraphicsRenderer::SetSwapInterval on any renderer.
SDL_GPU stored the stencil reference without applying it (missing SDL_SetGPUStencilReference).
SDL_GPU captured DepthBias but omitted it from the snapshot and pipeline key, replaying every draw with zero bias.
